description: MainActivity.java for an Android Wearable application managing voice recording, playback, and media playback using UI animation and permissions handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android Wearable activity managing recording, playback, and UI state transitions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, sets content view, and configures progress bar.

methods.name: onUIStateChanged
methods.description: Handles UI state changes such as starting/stopping recording and playback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets up UI animation and sound recorder after permissions are granted.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Checks device support and permissions when activity starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as recorder, media player, and countdown timer.

methods.name: onPlaybackStopped
methods.description: Callback for stopping playback, transitions UI back to home state.

methods.name: speakerIsSupported
methods.description: Determines if device has a supported built-in speaker (Android M+).
